name: Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information
principle: The product stores sensitive data at rest in cleartext in a resource that another control sphere may access. Anyone who can read that resource can recover the data; encoding is reversible and is not protection.
detection_signals: Java response.addCookie(new Cookie(name, password|token|acctID|ssn)) without encryption before Cookie construction
PHP setcookie(name, username|password|token|acctID) without openssl_encrypt/sodium_crypto_secretbox before setcookie
C/C++ write/fwrite/ofstream << password|token|secret buffer without EVP_EncryptUpdate/CryptProtectData before the storage sink
Java Files.write/FileOutputStream/Properties.store writes password|secret|token values without Cipher.doFinal before write
Windows RegSetValueEx stores password|token|secret data without CryptProtectData before RegSetValueEx
Cloud IaC/API creates S3/GCS/Azure blob storage for sensitive data with missing ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration/encryption at rest setting
negative_signals: Cipher.doFinal/EVP_EncryptUpdate/crypto_secretbox/CryptProtectData output is the exact value passed to the storage sink
Android EncryptedSharedPreferences, iOS Keychain, Java KeyStore, or OS credential vault stores the secret
S3 BucketEncryption/ServerSideEncryption AES256 or aws:kms, GCS defaultKmsKeyName, or Azure encryption scope is enabled for the storage resource
The data flow only goes to a network send API and is not persisted to file, cookie, registry, database, memory dump, environment, or cloud storage
Stored value is a salted one-way password hash from bcrypt/scrypt/Argon2/PBKDF2 and the plaintext password is not stored
false_defense_traps: Base64, hex, URL encoding, compression, or serialization before storage
TLS/HTTPS on transport while the at-rest value remains cleartext
Signed cookie or signed JWT without encryption; integrity is not confidentiality
File permissions, private bucket ACLs, or database grants as the only protection for plaintext secrets
Encryption key hard-coded, stored beside ciphertext, or committed in the same configuration repository
verification_focus: Does sensitive data reach any persistent or inspectable storage sink without real encryption before the write, and can another control sphere read that resource?

consequence_chains.trigger: Attacker obtains read access to the storage resource containing cleartext sensitive data
Cleartext sensitive cookie exists and an XSS flaw can read document.cookie
consequence_chains.consequence: Remote attacker steals the stored cookie value

consequence_chains.trigger: Unauthenticated storage bucket or endpoint contains unencrypted sensitive objects

patch_principle: Encrypt sensitive data before storage using vetted authenticated encryption and managed keys.
Use platform storage protections: cloud at-rest encryption/KMS, OS credential vaults, EncryptedSharedPreferences, KeyStore, or Keychain.
Do not persist passwords, tokens, session secrets, or PII unless required; store references or short-lived tokens instead.
Protect keys separately from ciphertext and rotate/revoke keys as needed.
Map to a more specific child CWE when the storage location is known, such as file, registry, cookie, memory, GUI, executable, or environment variable.
